# HTML to plain text

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/html-to-text/

Convert pasted HTML into plain text while removing scripts, style blocks and embedded controls. Preserve useful line breaks for common block elements.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Turn a short HTML email fragment into plain text for another editor.

## Limits and checks

The tool extracts content, not visual layout. Image descriptions and complex table formatting may need manual review.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
